title: Cervical Cancer Risk Reduction — Vaccinated Before Age 17

source.name: Lei J, et al. 'HPV Vaccination and the Risk of Invasive Cervical Cancer'

notes: A nationwide Swedish cohort study (NEJM, 2020) found an 88% reduction in invasive cervical cancer among women vaccinated before age 17, versus unvaccinated women (63% overall). Recalled from the published study; not live-refreshed this run because outbound network access was unavailable in this session.
